title: Exercise 6: Detach and Reattach with tmux
description: Six commands create a persistent tmux session, change to an exercise directory, launch claude with a multi-step goal, detach with Ctrl-b d, list sessions to confirm it exists, then reattach to inspect progress.

steps.description: The sequence creates session 'ex6', runs claude inside it, detaches with Ctrl-b then d, confirms the session persists with tmux ls, and reattaches to see progress made while detached.
Line 4 is the detach keystroke: the agent keeps running on the multiplexer's persistent server after you close the view.

steps.question: What confirms the agent kept working while you were gone?
steps.answer: reattached session shows progress made after detach (new files, more test output, or a completed task)
